rules: Bound server company/profile. Only already cached done documents from received PDF service.
Port list returns at most20 descriptors, no page bodies. read accepts SHA256 and1-2distinct page numbers within cached pageCount.
Read returns at most6000 Unicode codepoints per page, maximum12000total, explicit truncated flag, fullpage hash and excerpt hash distinct.
Page reference includes immutable document bytes hash and extractor version, one-based page and full pageTextHash.
Citation URL is the received fixed public URL with #page=N, never arbitrary PDF content link.
externalCalls=0 for reads. Never download/extract/retry through a model tool.
A received financial report proves its own text, not supplier delay, private company relationship or scenario fire.
Missing/pending/failed/uncertain document yields not_available with no text; storage errors sanitized and no implicit retry.
